bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
sql="SELECT CASE WHEN (d.data->'media'->>'type')='video' AND d.data::text LIKE '%動画付きのリンク%' THEN 'VIDEO_AND_BUTTON' WHEN (d.data->'media'->>'type')='video' THEN 'VIDEO_ONLY' WHEN d.data::text LIKE '%動画付きのリンク%' THEN 'BUTTON_ONLY' WHEN d.step='awaiting_text' THEN 'ENTRY' WHEN d.data ? 'shareCode' THEN 'REGISTERED' ELSE 'OTHER' END FROM public_post_drafts d WHERE d.module='link' AND d.owner_user_id IN (SELECT owner_user_id FROM link_button_posts WHERE content='個別編集済みの安全テスト') LIMIT 1;"
state="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$sql")" || exit 61
case "$state" in VIDEO_AND_BUTTON)exit 80;;VIDEO_ONLY)exit 81;;BUTTON_ONLY)exit 82;;ENTRY)exit 83;;REGISTERED)exit 84;;*)exit 85;;esac
